f3.en: Six reasons families and caregivers on both sides of the Tasman choose to work with us.
f3.zh: 这六大优势，是新西兰与澳大利亚两地家庭和月嫂选择与我们合作的原因。

f5.en: Every caregiver completes our structured training program and holds relevant certification before placement.
f5.zh: 每位月嫂上岗前均完成系统培训，并持有相关资质认证。

f7.en: All caregivers pass background checks and reference verification, for your family's peace of mind.
f7.zh: 所有月嫂均经过背景调查与推荐人核实，让您安心放心。

f9.en: Our coordination team and most caregivers communicate fluently in both English and Mandarin.
f9.zh: 我们的协调团队及大部分月嫂均可中英双语流利沟通。

f11.en: We take time to understand your family's needs before matching you with the right caregiver.
f11.zh: 我们深入了解每个家庭的需求，为您匹配最合适的月嫂。

f13.en: From New Zealand training to Australian placement, our team supports both sides of every arrangement.
f13.zh: 从新西兰培训到澳大利亚上岗，我们的团队全程双向支持。

f15.en: Live-in or live-out, short-term or extended stays — we tailor the arrangement to your family.
f15.zh: 住家或非住家、短期或长期，我们为您灵活安排服务形式。
